evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.897 Torr at growth setpoints of 750 C and 100 sccm Ar, consistent with the preceding ramp baseline.
Pressure rose progressively to 3.052 Torr despite unchanged growth setpoints.
Pressure has risen further to 3.175 Torr, approximately 9.6% above the 2640 s baseline; temperature remains near setpoint at 750.3 C and Ar flow at 99.2 sccm. Heater power is 44.7%.
No exhaust oxygen sensor is installed; pressure and Ar flow cannot establish atmospheric purity.

args.missing_evidence: Independent pressure confirmation and checks of exhaust conductance and tube sealing are needed to distinguish restriction, leakage, or gauge error; oxygen measurement is needed to verify atmosphere. No sample characterization is available.
